claims.assertion: Mari Swa says Taygetan ships dock side by side through hangar doors and an extendable sealed platform; shields must share harmonics to merge during contact, and mismatched shields repel.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: Docking is effectively unshielded from both ships’ perspective.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa attributes an Alcyone-Saska collision to failed rear sensors and Alcyone’s premature turn; Saska’s reinforced bow damaged Alcyone’s rear superstructure, later replaced by modular sections.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She reports no injuries or Saska damage.

review_flags: This is a first-person account of a spacecraft accident and unverified shield and sensor technology.
coverage_gaps: The report also describes crew decompression procedures and the limits of self-repairing polymorphic titanium.
